name: How long does it take to replace a window with a rotted frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a window with a rotted frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline can vary depending on the extent of the rot and the type of window being installed. A single window replacement, assuming moderate rot that needs remediation, typically takes a professional crew a few hours. For multiple windows or severe structural rot requiring extensive carpentry, the duration can extend to several days per project. Preparation and finishing also factor into the total time.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single window with moderate rot can take a few hours; multiple windows or severe rot may take several days.
